mr: Mr is a form of address for a man.
Mr means the same as Mister or Mr..
Mr. is a form of address for a man.
Mr. means the same as Mister or Mr.
mr. moto: Mr. Moto is Japanese sleuth created by John Marquand.
mrd: MRD is a machine-readable version of a standard dictionary.
MRD means the same as machine readable dictionary or electronic dictionary.
mrem: A mrem is a dosage of ionizing radiation equivalent to one thousandth of a rem.
Mrem means the same as millirem.
mri: MRI is the use of nuclear magnetic resonance of protons to produce proton density images.
MRI means the same as magnetic resonance imaging.
mrna: A mRNA is the template for protein synthesis.
MRNA means the same as messenger RNA or template RNA or informational RNA.
mrs: Mrs is a form of address for a married woman.
Mrs means the same as Mrs..
Mrs. is a form of address for a married woman.
Mrs. means the same as Mrs.
mrs. gandhi: Mrs. Gandhi is daughter of Nehru who served as prime minister of India from 1966 to 1977.
Mrs. Gandhi means the same as Gandhi or Indira Gandhi or Indira Nehru Gandhi.
mrs. henry wood: Mrs. Henry Wood is English writer of novels about murders and thefts and forgeries.
Mrs. Henry Wood means the same as Wood or Ellen Price Wood.
mrs. humphrey ward: Mrs. Humphrey Ward is English writer of novels who was an active opponent of the women's suffrage movement.
Mrs. Humphrey Ward means the same as Ward or Mary Augusta Arnold Ward.
mrs. simpson: Mrs. Simpson is United States divorcee whose marriage to Edward VIII created a constitutional crisis leading to his abdication.
Mrs. Simpson means the same as Simpson or Wallis Warfield Simpson or Wallis Warfield Windsor.
mrta: MRTA is a Marxist-Leninist terrorist organization in Peru.
MRTA means the same as Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement or Movimiento Revolucionario Tupac Anaru.
